title: HYPERION: Coevolution of supermassive black holes and galaxies at z > 6 and the build-up of massive galaxies
question: Cold-dust SED (dust temperature, mass, emissivity, SFR), molecular gas mass, gas-to-dust ratio and star formation efficiency of ten z>6 QSOs, used to judge the co-evolution of SMBHs and host galaxies and whether QSO hosts are progenitors of local massive galaxies

recipe.goal: Image continuum and line cubes from archive-calibrated data
recipe.method: Archive calibration; CASA tclean natural weighting, 3 sigma threshold; continuum via MFS in line-free channels; uvcontsub for line cubes
key_parameters: uvcontsub polynomial order 1 for J0224-4711, 0 for others

recipe.goal: Measure continuum flux densities and sizes, with tapering for extended emission
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fit in CASA; peak flux taken as total for unresolved sources; tapered maps for higher-resolution data to recover extended emission

recipe.goal: Correct J231-20 Band 8 flux for the close companion
recipe.method: Subtract companion contribution using Pensabene2021 SED: companion 0.6 dex fainter than QSO at ~400 GHz, highest-temperature model; result 6.74 +/- 0.31 mJy used as detection in the SED fit
assumptions: Companion flux is 0.6 dex below QSO flux at ~400 GHz

recipe.method: Moment maps from thresholded continuum-subtracted cubes; spectrum from S/N>2 region; single-Gaussian fit of line profile; 2D Gaussian fit of line maps; luminosities from Solomon et al. formulae
key_parameters: moment-map threshold 2.5 sigma (J0224-4711) or 3 sigma (J1319+0950, J2054-0005)

recipe.goal: Fit the cold-dust SED with an optically thick modified black body
recipe.method: MBB with CMB correction; free T_dust, M_dust, beta; MCMC with uniform priors
key_parameters: Solid angle from continuum mean size of resolved observations
assumptions: Optically thick regime; opacity law from beelen+2006/carniani2019

recipe.goal: Derive L_TIR and star formation rate
recipe.method: Integrate best-fit model over 8-1000 micron rest frame; SFR proportional to L_TIR with Kroupa IMF; SFR reduced for 50% AGN contribution to dust heating

recipe.goal: Derive molecular gas masses from CO
recipe.method: M_H2 = alpha_CO / r_J-(J-1) x L'_CO; r65 and r76 from APM0879+5255 and Cloverleaf

recipe.goal: Compare dust properties, GDR and SFE with literature samples and fit T_dust-z
recipe.method: Compile local and high-z comparison samples; fit T_dust(z) = A(1+z)^B to all sources and to QSOs only; GDR from M_gas/M_dust; SFE = SFR/M_H2

recipe.goal: Classify evolutionary regime via BH and galaxy growth efficiencies
recipe.method: Compare G_gal = SFR/M_gal with G_BH = (1-eps) Mdot_BH/M_BH; slope angle >45 deg BH-dominated, ~45 symbiotic, <45 galaxy-dominated
key_parameters: radiative efficiency eps=0.1; BH masses from MgII
assumptions: SFR corrected for 50% AGN contribution; Mdot_BH from L_bol
